newsitem.title: USA: Diana amends Nasdaq filing, NYSE delisting.
newsitem.headline: Diana amends Nasdaq filing, NYSE delisting.

text.p: Diana Corp Friday said it filed an application January 7 to list its stock on Nasdaq and amended that filing February 13 after its sale of assets of Atlanta Provision Co.

Diana said the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) will begin delisting action regarding its stock as it has substantially reduced its operations with the sale. On Thursday, Diana said it sees no immediate liquidity crisis and will continue working with customers to collect $8.3 million in accounts receivable.
Diana also confirmed that chairman and chief executive James Fiedler bought 15,000 shares on February 13 and 14 at an average price of $11.33 per share.
